analysis_summary: The document describes a 2026 world of frontier AI labs, aggressive government action, a dense stream of AI incidents (evaluation escapes, deepfakes, chatbot-caused harm, algorithmic pricing), and a noisy information layer of media, trackers, prediction markets, expert voices and covert advocacy networks. The entity design therefore separates labs, government bodies, media, expert commentators, advocacy and sock-puppet groups, affected individuals, implicated non-frontier companies, and monitoring bodies, with Person and Organization as fallbacks. Relations model the core social-media dynamics: reporting, commenting, official response, support/opposition, litigation, lobbying and deceptive impersonation.
